note: Properties to ADD to the existing Properties database. Nothing existing is renamed, removed or edited.

properties.name: Web Listing Status
properties.defaultBehaviour: Not Published. Blank or unrecognised also means Not Published, so nothing can go live.
properties.mapsTo: Not stored. It is the visibility gate: Published, Under Offer and Sold set snapshot.commercialStatus (Available, Under offer, Sold); Draft, In Review and Approved are checked but never proposed; Withdrawn and Not Published are never proposed.

properties.name: Web Public Address
properties.mapsTo: content.address { street, suburb, state, postcode }. Also the source of the slug. There is no field for a house or unit number.

properties.name: Web Description
properties.defaultBehaviour: Blank blocks publication. The CRM Description is never used.
properties.mapsTo: content.description[] (one entry per paragraph). The first paragraph becomes the summary shown on cards.

properties.name: Web Approved By
properties.defaultBehaviour: Blank blocks publication. The person must also be on approvers.json (by Notion user id).
properties.mapsTo: snapshot.approvedBy and snapshot.approvedById. Not shown on any page.

properties.name: Web Display Price
properties.defaultBehaviour: Blank is correct for EOI and Contact Agent. Required for Asking Price and Price Guide; filling it for the other two modes is reported and ignored.
properties.mapsTo: content.pricing.display, formatted as "$695,000 AUD". Never copied from the CRM Price.

properties.name: Web Photo Folder
properties.mapsTo: Not stored and never read by the website. A human pointer to the SharePoint "Approved for Website" folder.

derivedNotCreated.name: slug
derivedNotCreated.rule: letters and hyphens only; a letter suffix if another property shares the street; frozen once published

derivedNotCreated.name: approval time
derivedNotCreated.rule: the moment the snapshot is proposed; git history is the record

derivedNotCreated.name: public listing id
derivedNotCreated.rule: lst_ + first 10 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the page id
